description: Reviewed degenerate-release-surface exclusions for the UK terminal battery (#630, schema 2 per #610). Each entry is a complete approval receipt: reason, approver, adjudication reference, approval date, and expiry. The gate reports dormant entries, FAILS stale ones (columns that regain signal), and FAILS expired ones until the adjudication is renewed, so this register cannot rot.

household.source_year.reason: Constant at the build vintage by construction on a single-vintage artifact, and fully derivable from the artifact's time_period metadata (the rowwise clone path re-derives it when absent). Retained deliberately for row-level vintage documentation and UK/US schema symmetry — the US pools three ASEC vintages, where the same column is irreducible per-row identity. Not signal.
